thread:
victor: Quick sync  launching a small pricing experiment next month. Need owners for CSV schema, manual-invoice gating, and vendor carve-outs.

maya: I can own the CSV ingestion. What fields do we need?

victor: rate_code, grandfather_until (epoch), retro_allow (bool), manual_flag, review_id. Also a small risk_score column to help AR triage.

ryan: A/B plan: A = current rate, B = new tiered. Canary 5% for 7 days. Exclude reserved capacity + any vendor with "no-retro" clauses. I'll produce cohort + excludes.

helen: Legal will scan contracts for retro/commitment clauses. If any vendor requires consent for retro credits, we must carve those accounts out or get approval.

tori: AR asks: flag invoices where absolute delta > $1.2k or pct delta > 25%. Use risk_score to prioritize. Auto-export flagged items to AR sheet and create ticket.

maya: Sample CSV row: 
account_id,rate_code,qty,grandfather_until,retro_allow,manual_flag,review_id,risk_score
ACCT-9,price_new_t1,100,0,true,false,,0.2

billing-bot: preflight checks: schema-validate, risk_score-populate, staging-sim, cohort-exclude. All must pass in staging.

victor: Gating for canary -> ramp: staging invoice success > 99.5%, median invoice drift <10%, manual-review queue < 50 items, est retro liability < $9k.

ryan: I'll add delayed-ingest excludes (>48h backfill). Also sharing opt-in list from sales.

helen: Posting carve-out list by EOD Thu. If >15 accounts require manual consent we need a fallback plan.

tori: AR sheet template ready: https://sheets.redwood.co/AR-PRICING-2201. Webhook will create tickets with review_id and risk_score.

maya: I'll open PR with schema + small sim harness and include webhook docs.

victor: Action items recap: Maya  PR + webhook; Ryan  cohort & excludes; Helen  legal carve-outs; Tori  AR sheet automation. Approvals: Legal, RevOps, Finance Lead before canary.

ryan: PR link?

maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/billing/compare/price-experiment-schema. Running staging tests now.

victor: Thanks all. Keep updates in-thread. Flag any vendor constraints immediately so we can decide carve-outs before canary. :thumbsup:
